name: grademe
description: Grades a Claude Code session against the 7-dimension vibe-coding rubric; outputs scored JSON + Bahasa Indonesia coaching. v0.7.2 (fully deterministic scoring — the LLM leaves the scoring path): scoring now lives entirely in `validate.py`, exposed as a new entrypoint `validate.py --score --digest D.json` -> `{breakdown, total_score, applicable_dimensions, na_dimensions, weights_applied, score_basis}`; the grader subagent returns ONLY `{misses, next_session_advice, prompt_analysis}` (typed misses `{dimension, counter, observed, text}`, plain strings still accepted for one version) — the band targets were already deterministic in v0.7.1, so the grader's score carried zero variance while costing a dispatch and an entire retry failure class. New rule 9 applicability clamps (anti-ritual): without `substantive_work` / `deep_investigation` / `verified_greenfield`, planning/decomposition/delegation/documentation clamp to Mid (10/10/12/3) and verification clamps to 13. N/A + imputation: `verification` (nothing changed), `documentation` (nothing changed and no doc write) and `token_efficiency` (<12 tool calls) are marked N/A and IMPUTED at the session's own rate, so all 7 breakdown keys survive inside their documented maxima and `total_score == sum(breakdown)` holds by construction (`decomposition` N/A deferred). Digest repairs: async subagent telemetry now joins via `<task-notification>` records + on-disk `subagents/` sidecar (BACKLOG #23 — those records are also no longer miscounted as user turns; one real session went 63 -> 90), `consumed_dispatches` matched against the FULL subagent report, plan artifacts no longer set the first-edit boundary while subagent edits now do, `plan_revisions` no longer fabricated and plan gates canonicalized, `redundant_read_pairs`/suppression/`TEST_OUTPUT_RE`/`TEST_CMD_RE` (`--selftest` was unreachable behind a `\b`)/`errors_followed_up` (causal window W=10 + widened responsive-action set)/`doc_writes` (real doc paths + subagent sidecar) all repaired, `session_name` skips harness command wrappers, `isMeta` used as a structural boilerplate marker, `cache_ratio` dropped from scoring (harness property, kept as forensic), zero-assistant sessions now exit 3 with a correct message. 20 new counters in `evidence_metrics` (25 -> 45, work-path filtered) and `digest_schema_version` -> 7 (`validate.py` requires >= 4). Two additional scoring paths shipped post-release: `verification_probes_linked >= 1` lifts verification from floor 6 to band 10 when `test_commands == 0` (a targeted probe against something this session changed proves "I checked the state I changed", not "I have a repeatable regression test" — so it stays below the 13 test-evidence tier), and a minimum-activity guard assigns `BAND_FLOOR` instead of imputed points when `activity_signal == 0`, reported via `score_basis.na_basis`. Empty plan gates (`planExists:false`) are excluded from both the gate set and planning's effective count via `empty_plan_gates`. Compaction no longer filters any counter — the JSONL keeps its pre-compaction records, so a compacted session is scored on the whole transcript (the filtering version crushed the corpus's two best sessions 93->44 and 90->44). Payload adds 4 additive top-level keys (`applicable_dimensions`, `na_dimensions` = `{reason, imputed_points, basis}`, `weights_applied`, `score_basis` = `{earned_applicable, max_applicable, activity_signal, na_basis}`) absorbed into `raw_payload` with ZERO backend/frontend change anywhere in this release; `grademe_version` -> `0.7.2`. Measured effect on 128 real sessions (v0.7.1 -> v0.7.2): median 53 -> 53.5, p75 66.25 -> 76, max 93 -> 97, min 34 -> 30; 118/128 sessions moved (59 up / 59 down) with Spearman 0.938 against v0.7.1 — the ranking largely holds, the range is what changed. Honest limits: pure ritual is only PARTLY closed — the adversarial fixture `test-transcripts/pure-ritual.jsonl` (every rubric ceremony, zero modifications to pre-existing files) drops 96 -> 75 (v0.7.1: 97) now that rule 9's dispatch credit requires `consumed_dispatches >= 1` and its greenfield arm requires `code_files_created >= 1`, but 75 is still 1 point above the <=74 design target because `context` (15) and `token_efficiency` (12) carry no applicability clamp by design; measured impact of that phase-7 change alone on the n=128 corpus is zero; `artifact_dispersion` and `no_edits_anywhere` are emitted but unscored, and v0.6.0 leaderboard scores are NOT comparable. Known open items (tracked as BACKLOG #24-#34, summarized in CHANGELOG's "what to optimise next"): external-service verification is still invisible when the session diagnoses before it fixes (~11 corpus sessions; one scored 37 despite testing a live API end-to-end), a bare skill invocation with no downstream action still clears the activity guard, `errors_followed_up` measures "kept working around the failure" rather than proven causality (placebo lift only 1.04), legacy plain-string `misses` bypasses every structural check and needs an expiry version, nothing in the repo knows the backend's real types (the `[]string` fact lives only in a comment and an error string), and the P5 blind-ranking discrimination test has not been run — so "the score reflects real quality" remains unvalidated. v0.7.1 (tightened gates + deterministic band-target ceilings): `evidence_metrics` grows 20->25 counters (test_commands_with_output, todo_distinct_items, todo_items_completed, consumed_dispatches, reads_of_edited_files) with per-segment test-command gating (`pytest --version`/`go test -h` no longer count as real execution); `validate.py` tightens rule 3 (verification High now requires real test-runner output, delegation now requires consumed_dispatches/mcp_substantive instead of raw mcp_calls or decoy dispatches, decomposition High requires todo_distinct_items>=3, context High requires evidence the context was actually used, doc_write_max_chars threshold 40->200) and adds rule 8 `_check_band_targets` — a deterministic per-dimension ceiling computed straight from the counters, closing within-band discretion; `grademe_version` -> `0.7.1`. v0.7.0 (evidence-based matrix): scoring kini murni dari aksi teramati — `digest.py` emits `evidence_metrics` (20 deterministic counters) and the grader maps them via a MATRIX (Low/Mid/High) per dimension instead of free judgment; ALL v0.6.0 forced caps removed (`score_caps` short_session->85/no_friction->89, misses>=2 quota, total cap 98) — a session earns whatever its counters prove, no structural ceiling; `validate.py` now enforces a ONE-WAY consistency gate (a claimed high band without supporting counters is mechanically rejected; a lower score is always allowed); payload adds `user_prompts` (ALL genuine user prompts verbatim in order, per-prompt truncated at 4000 chars, 150k char total budget) uploaded alongside `first_user_prompt` for originality audit, plus `evidence_metrics` itself; `FORENSIC_FIELDS` now 10 (adds `user_prompts`+`evidence_metrics`); anti-hand-authored cap 70 and foreign-harness hard reject retained; `grademe_version` -> `0.7.0`. v0.6.0 (anti-gaming): bobot rubrik direbalance (planning 15, context 15, decomposition 15, delegation 18, verification 20, token_efficiency 12, documentation 5); `misses` WAJIB ≥2 di setiap sesi → total_score efektif maks 98 (aturan lama "misses kosong ↔ ≥95" dihapus); score caps deterministik dari `work_evidence` (sesi <15 menit/<5 user turn → cap 85, tanpa friksi tertangani → cap 89); deteksi prompt sintetis (rubric-engineered) dari `first_user_prompt`+`work_evidence`; `scripts/validate.py` jadi gerbang mekanis wajib sebelum presentasi/upload; `first_user_prompt` dikirim ke leaderboard untuk audit kecurangan; hard reject total (STOP, tanpa fallback) untuk transcript harness non-Claude-Code. v0.5.0: dimensi `delegation` kini menilai orkestrasi skill & subagent secara terukur (D1 subagent / D2 skill / D3 MCP) dari sinyal ground-truth yang tidak diarang peserta — `toolUseResult` (telemetri subagent: dipakai/decoy), `attributionSkill` (dwell-turn: dipakai vs invoke-and-ignore), slash-command user-initiated; sesi tanpa skill+subagent dibatasi ≤6/15. digest.py membaca toolUseResult/attribution/attachment/sidecar subagents + emit blok `tool_usage`+`signal_availability`; laundering compact via teks prosa ditutup (hanya marker terstruktur / pesan pertama); `ERROR_RE` diperluas (FAIL/panic) + flag `suppressed` untuk `|| true`/`; exit 0`/`--no-verify`; calibration anchor + evidence-first di prompt grader (lawan ceiling-drift). v0.4.1: fix bug nyata — file sementara /tmp/grademe_digest.json dkk kini per-transkrip (${TAG} suffix) alih-alih path fixed, mencegah grading membaca digest/submission basi milik sesi/peserta lain; ditambah assertion session_id digest vs sesi teresolve. v0.4.0: payload upload lengkap — prompt_analysis kini DIKIRIM (v0.3.0 keliru men-strip-nya), plus usage_totals, type_counts, dan grademe_version; fallback strip-on-400 dihapus. v0.3.0: mandatory live-session grading (env/nonce detection ladder), digest.py preprocessing (~10-160x smaller than raw JSONL), session_name + compacted flag in output, endpoint pindah ke venturo.pro.
